verdict: The exact M1796 RTL is an additive fault-cone-only successor: the public protocol_error is assigned only in one synchronous sticky register, request and response accept comparisons are valid-qualified, the frozen M519 data/control core and M803 eight-bank adapter remain unchanged, and the full testbench retains the five exact K8/K1x8 cycle pairs plus numeric, tuple, weight, completion, stall, reset, and public illegal-header/raw/response gates. The source package is nevertheless not launchable. Its fail-closed checker does not bind either top-level owner-enable equation, and the advertised 19-mutation suite accepts both core_fault_sample_enable=0 and adapter_fault_sample_enable=0. Those mutations silently hide real owner-active faults while every author check still passes. The full-testbench PASS token also prints protocol_attacks=4 although the hard gate requires and executes five attacks. No VCS or later EDA is authorized until an additive successor closes these evidence defects and receives a fresh different-author review.

rtl: protocol_error has exactly one reset-to-zero and one sticky-set-to-one nonblocking assignment and no combinational public assignment.

Request and response accept mismatch predicates are qualified by core_req_valid and core_rsp_valid, respectively; invalid payload under valid=0 is isolated without force, initreg, ignore-X, case-equality coercion, or a constant-zero output.
The exact diff against M803 preserves every data, ready/valid, issue, Acc24, result, token-done, memory-port, and debug connection outside the public fault boundary.

The current owner enables include header_valid, raw_valid, core_busy, core_mem_req_valid, core_mem_rsp_valid, result_valid, token_done_valid, adapter_busy, and any mem_rsp_valid. Source inspection finds the child current illegal predicates valid/state-qualified.
testbench: The unit boundary test covers valid0 X payload isolation, four independent fault sources, sticky sampling, posedge/negedge/half-cycle binary checks, and multi-cycle reset.
The full successor test blocks K8 illegal header, illegal raw, and spurious bank response accepts, then observes sticky protocol_error and later runs clean legal transactions after reset.

The full regression retains five exact cycle pairs 51/53, 131/133, 486/499, 1231/1246, and 14/14, plus numeric, tuple, weight, request/response conservation, backpressure, out-of-order response, Acc24 result, and completion identity checks.

findings.title: The fail-closed checker does not bind the owner-activity equations that prevent real faults from being masked
findings.evidence: The critical equations are M1796 top lines 144-148. audit_top at checker lines 98-126 checks the fault-export instance and request/response wiring, but never requires either enable assignment. The 19-mutation suite at test lines 40-73 has no enable-removal mutation. Independently replacing the full core equation or adapter equation with assign ... = 1'b0 is accepted by audit_top.
findings.risk: A source package can claim registered public-fault repair while permanently suppressing core or adapter owner-active illegals, including header/raw/internal request or bank-response faults, and still receive PASS_M1796_SOURCE_ONLY_NO_EDA_NO_ATTEMPT plus 19/19 mutations.
findings.required_fix: In an additive successor, make audit_top require the exact normalized core and adapter owner-enable sets, require every exported event/accept-valid connection exactly once, and add independent mutations that delete or constant-zero each owner term and each complete enable equation. Also bind multi-cycle reset followed by a legal full transaction and the three real K8 accept-zero/sticky attacks. Re-run CPython 3.6 and 3.12 before a fresh different-author hammer.

findings.title: The sole full-regression PASS token reports the wrong protocol-attack count
findings.evidence: The initial sequence executes two header attacks, one K8 raw attack, and two response attacks; lines 1123-1126 hard-gate protocol_attack_count==5. Line 1139 nevertheless prints protocol_attacks=4, and audit_tb accepts arbitrary replacement of that printed value.
findings.risk: A future machine receipt will contain a self-contradictory coverage statement even when the simulation gates the correct count.
findings.required_fix: Print the live protocol_attack_count or the exact literal 5, distinguish total attacks from the three K8-specific attack classes if desired, and add a checker mutation for the PASS-token count.

required_next_gate: Create an additive corrected successor without modifying M1796 or M1797; close M1797-P1-01 and M1797-P2-01; obtain a fresh different-author source hammer with P0=0 and P1=0; only then may one fresh VCS attempt containing the boundary and full K8-vs-K1x8 campaigns be released.
